thread:
jo (sales): ProspectHealth wants a 2-week POC. Need SSO (SAML), SCIM group sync -> RBAC, domain proofing and a dedicated node quote. Dana which domains and compliance must-haves?

dana (ProspectHealth): prod.prospecthealth.com and auth.prospecthealth.com. Require 1-year audit logs, customer-managed KMS for logs, and ability to restrict access by CIDR during pilot.

rachel (solutions): Plan: SAML SP info (ACS=https://api.redwood.ai/saml/acs/ph-poc, EntityID=https://redwood.ai/saml/ph-poc), support encrypted assertions, both SP/IdP flows. SCIM v2 endpoint https://api.redwood.ai/scim/ph-poc/v2, token per env.

rachel (solutions): Suggested SCIM group->role mapping: clinicians->clinician, platform->platform-admin, contractors->limited. Recommend delta sync 10m during POC.

omar (security): Checklist: enable KMS (we'll need key ARN), set audit retention 365 days, IP allowlist for pilot endpoints, provide SOC2 + DPA. Do you need mTLS?

dana (ProspectHealth): No mTLS for pilot. We'll send key ARN and CIDR today. Also need confirmation on user reconciliation if people have multiple emails.

rachel (solutions): Use SCIM externalId as canonical id; we'll include reconcile step and an import tool. Also recommend adding externalId from Okta.

jo (sales): Pricing: shared pilot = credits. Dedicated 1-node pilot = $7k flat for two weeks (includes KMS and extended audit). Private deploy = longer lead time. If Dedicated chosen, need PO + CIDR + signed order by Thursday to hit next-week start.

dana (ProspectHealth): We'll do Dedicated. PO and CIDR incoming tonight.

omar (security): We'll attach vendor sec-qa; please return completed form with PO. We'll also provision a secure export bucket for audit exports.

kevin (legal): On DPA/export controls: send any health-data clauses you require. We'll flag liability cap and data processing scope on the order form.

rachel (solutions): I'll post the metadata XML, SCIM test token, and DNS TXT template for domain verification in this thread shortly. DNS example: _rw-ver=ph-poc-abc123.

jo (sales): Action items: dana -> PO, CIDR, key ARN, 3 test users per group. rachel -> metadata + SCIM token + peering checklist. omar -> sec-qa template. kevin -> review PO DPA terms.

dana (ProspectHealth): Got it, thanks all.
